english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for reading text, including text read in a particular direction and technical signals when the context is clear.

examples.english: I read the newspaper every day.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 duk6 bou3 zi2

english.note: Use 讀 for taking or being enrolled in an academic subject, including studying a subject as an academic course.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 sam1 lei5 hok6
